title: image/v5.40.0 gets "registries.conf must be in v2 format but is in v1" error with missing /etc/containers/registries.conf
body: Prior to version image/v5.40.0, the library allowed `/etc/containers/registries.conf` to be missing.  Now it gives a confusing error `registries.conf must be in v2 format but is in v1` rather than ignoring the file as it used to or at least saying that the file is missing (e.g. in apptainer/apptainer#3651).  Can the old behavior of silently ignoring the missing config file be restored?

comments.body:
Please provide a concrete reproducer. Our podman 6 packing ships without a /etc/containers/registries.conf file so it seems very clear to me that this must work  fine.
The error should be what it says it is? We dropped support for v1 configs and you seem to have at least once v1 config in the searched config paths.
